definitions.gloss: average score, average mark, mean score
definitions.explanation: The arithmetic mean of test scores or grades. Commonly used in academic contexts to refer to the class or national average on an exam.

examples.japanese: {平均点|へいきんてん}は65{点|てん}だった。
{今回|こんかい}のテストは{平均点|へいきんてん}が{低|ひく}かった。
examples.english: The average score on this test was low.

examples.japanese: {数学|すうがく}の{平均点|へいきんてん}を{上回|うわまわ}ったので、{少|すこ}し{安心|あんしん}した。
examples.english: I was a bit relieved to have scored above the average in math.

notes:
A compound of {平均|へいきん} (average) and {点|てん} (point, score). One of the most commonly used academic terms in Japan, where test scores and averages are frequently discussed.

USAGE:
{平均点|へいきんてん}を{取|と}る means "to get the average score," while {平均点|へいきんてん}を{上回|うわまわ}る / {下回|したまわ}る means "to score above / below the average."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {平均点|へいきんてん}を{上回|うわまわ}る: to score above average
- {平均点|へいきんてん}を{下回|したまわ}る: to score below average
- {平均点|へいきんてん}が{高|たか}い: the average is high
- {平均点|へいきんてん}が{低|ひく}い: the average is low
- クラスの{平均点|へいきんてん}: the class average

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {平均|へいきん}: average — the general term for average, not limited to scores
- {偏差値|へんさち}: standard score, deviation score — a statistical measure widely used in Japanese education to rank students
- {合格|ごうかく}{点|てん}: passing score — the minimum score needed to pass
